he didn’t curse back. When he suffered
he didn’t threaten
but committed himself to him who judges righteously.
To sharp words he gave no sharp answer; when he was undergoing pain
no angry word came from his lips; but he put himself into the hands of the judge of righteousness:

giving his body to be nailed on the tree
so that we
being dead to sin
might have a new life in righteousness
and by his wounds we have been made well.

like sheep

which now saves you—not the putting away of the filth of the flesh
but the answer of a good conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ
And baptism

now gives you salvation
not by washing clean the flesh
but by making you free from the sense of sin before God
through the coming again of Jesus Christ from the dead;
